messages.subject: INLAOutputs PredPValue function
parts:
Hello All,

I am trying to do model evaluation with PredPvalue in INLAOutputs. It is not working for me and provide the following error message
'Error in `[.data.frame`(dat, , y_string) : undefined columns selected'
In the argument for the PredPvalue, object of class inla with computed fitted marginals need to be given instead of a column name. I am not certain why I am getting this error message. 

Thanks
Umanga

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] INLAOutputs PredPValue function
parts:
Hi,
If I found the correct GitHub repo for the INLAOutout package, it was last updated 7 years ago, and a lot has changed in inla since then, and the package author hasn’t kept their package up-to-date. You can try contacting them to see if they can fix their package to work with newer inla versions.

This is where I found the package repository:
oswaldosantos/INLAOutputs: R package to process selected outputs form the INLA package
github.com


Finn
